**`items/lem-chevalley-basis-and-real-structure-constants.md`** (new lemma, draft, 29 load-bearing deps, each also cited in the body).

**Statement proved** (no weakening; two precision refinements recorded): for any complex semisimple $\mathfrak g$, Cartan $\mathfrak h$, root system $\Phi$, and *arbitrary* prescribed nonzero $e_\alpha^0\in\mathfrak g_\alpha$, the vectors can be rescaled so that (i) $[e_\alpha,e_{-\alpha}]=h_\alpha$ (coroot), (ii) $N_{\alpha\beta}=-N_{-\alpha,-\beta}$ ($\beta=-\alpha$ excluded from the constants' definition), (iii) $N_{\alpha\beta}=\pm(p+1)\in\mathbb Z$ for the $\alpha$-string $\beta+n\alpha$ ($-p\le n\le q$); the real span of $\{h_\alpha,e_\alpha\}$ is then a split real form with integral structure constants, and the Knapp-normalised system $X_\alpha=((\alpha,\alpha)/2)^{1/2}e_\alpha$ has $[X_\alpha,X_{-\alpha}]=H_\alpha$, $B(X_\alpha,X_{-\alpha})=1$, real $C_{\alpha\beta}=-C_{-\alpha,-\beta}$ — exactly what the escalated consumers' remarks require.

**Proof** is complete and derived (not cited): bracket-coefficient lemma $[x,y]=+B(x,y)H_\alpha$; pairwise rescaling; Chevalley involution built from the **Serre presentation** (universal property), giving $\omega(\mathfrak g_\alpha)=\mathfrak g_{-\alpha}$ and, after a second rescaling, $\omega(e_\alpha)=-e_{-\alpha}$, hence (ii); a rank-two case analysis of Cartan integers proving the string-length identity $q(\alpha+\beta,\alpha+\beta)=(p+1)(\beta,\beta)$; the two-string $\mathfrak{sl}_2$-module/Pairing computation giving Chevalley's identity $N_{\alpha\beta}N_{-\alpha,-\beta}=-(p+1)^2$, hence (iii).
